The graph above shows $y={(\frac{1}{3})}^{x}+c$ . What is the value of $c?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The horizontal asymptote of $y={(\frac{1}{3})}^{x}$ is $y=0.$ 

The vertical translation $y={(\frac{1}{3})}^{x}+c$ shifts the asymptote to $y=c.$

In the graph above, the horizontal asymptote is $y=-5.$ Therefore, $c=-5.$
